# The judge needs numpy + scikit-learn and nothing else. No GPU, no service, and
# no network in the shipped (zero-token) configuration.
#
# Lower bounds, not pins, so this installs on a reviewer's existing environment.
# Built and verified on Python 3.14.5 / numpy 2.4.6 / scikit-learn 1.8.0.
#
# NOTE: artifacts/structural.pkl is a pickled scikit-learn ensemble and is
# therefore sensitive to the scikit-learn version. It is gitignored and
# regenerated by scripts/reproduce.sh (step 4), so a version mismatch cannot
# silently affect results -- retraining is part of the reproduction.
numpy>=1.26
